- Fix startup being slow with many multi identities
- Fix shell sessions and tunnels occasionally being stopped or restarted incorrectly when used from multiple places at the same time
- Fix multi-identities being moved to a different category when not all of their identities are accessible
- Fix local Windows shells breaking when the PATH contains quotes or is very long
- Fix the file browser overview flickering while loading
- Fix the window opening with a broken size when no proper monitor information is available
- Fix Proxmox webtop deployments being allowed on PVE 9.0, which does not support OCI containers yet
- Fix various NullPointers and small synchronization issues
